01-complaint.txt:
DRAFT TEMPLATE: FACTUAL COMPLAINT
Replace bracketed fields and remove inapplicable text. Use any prescribed official form where required. This is a request for administrative action, not an RTI application or statutory appeal.

To: [designation and office]
Date: [date]
Subject: Request for inspection of [observed issue] at [location]

I request your office to examine the following matter within its jurisdiction.

Location: [village/town, ward, taluka, landmark and map pin]
Survey/subdivision number: [if known; otherwise state not yet confirmed]
Date(s) and time(s) observed: [details]
Person/establishment involved: [only if known; identify the basis]

What I observed:
[Numbered, factual observations. Distinguish direct observation from information received from others. State whether the activity is ongoing.]

Effect or concern:
[Describe the observed effect and any immediate risk. Do not assert a legal conclusion or technical finding that has not been established.]

Action requested:
1. Please acknowledge this complaint and provide its reference number and the responsible office/officer.
2. Please inspect or assess the matter as appropriate and verify relevant permissions and conditions.
3. Please take action within your lawful powers where warranted, and provide a written response describing the action or reasons for the decision.
4. If this falls outside your jurisdiction, please identify the appropriate authority and inform me whether the complaint has been forwarded.

Previous related complaint: [reference, date, authority, or none]
Attachments: [numbered list of photos, location map, observations and relevant documents]

Name: [name]
Address for reply: [address]
Email/phone: [contact]
Signature: [if submitting on paper]

The facts above are accurate to the best of my knowledge. Unconfirmed information is identified as such.

Optional: [Explain a specific concern about disclosure of contact details and ask how they will be handled. This does not guarantee confidentiality.]

Submission record to keep separately: [date, method, inward/reference number, receipt or delivery evidence]
02-follow-up.txt:
DRAFT TEMPLATE: FOLLOW-UP OR ADMINISTRATIVE ESCALATION
This does not replace a statutory appeal. Check any applicable deadline separately.

To: [original office or appropriate supervisory/grievance officer]
Date: [date]
Subject: Follow-up on complaint [reference] dated [date] concerning [issue/location]

I submitted the attached complaint to [office] on [date]. Its acknowledgement/reference is [number].

Since then:
[List responses, inspections, promised dates and relevant developments chronologically. If a closure response is disputed, explain the specific discrepancy and attach current evidence.]

Current situation:
[What remains unresolved; whether the activity or impact continues.]

Please:
1. Confirm the present status and the office responsible for the next action.
2. Explain what action has been taken and provide or identify the relevant inspection/action record.
3. State the next action and expected timeframe, including any applicable notified service standard.
4. If the case is closed, provide the decision and reasons and identify any applicable review or appeal route.

If addressed to a supervisory office:
I request review of the attached history and appropriate action within your powers. Please let me know whether a prescribed form or separate statutory procedure is required.

Attachments: [original complaint; acknowledgement; replies; indexed new evidence]
Name and contact/address for reply: [details]
Signature: [if on paper]

Keep the delivery evidence and update the case log. A personal follow-up date should not be described as a statutory deadline.
03-rti-records-request.txt:
DRAFT TEMPLATE: RTI REQUEST FOR EXISTING RECORDS
For an Indian citizen. Address it to the relevant public authority's SPIO. Select the relevant questions; do not send every example indiscriminately. Follow the accepted form and fee/payment requirements.

To: The State Public Information Officer
[Public authority and address]
Date: [date]
Subject: Application under section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005

I am an Indian citizen and request the following records held by your authority.

Property/matter: [village/town, survey/subdivision number and location, or complaint reference]
Period covered: [start date to end date]

Select and adapt:
1. Copies of the development permission/technical clearance, building licence, sanctioned plans and approved amendments relating to [identified property/application].
2. Copies of inspection reports and recorded findings concerning [identified property or complaint].
3. Copies of notices, replies, orders, recorded decisions and action-taken records relating to complaint [reference/date].
4. A copy of the rule, circular, notified service standard or published checklist used by your authority for [identified service or decision].
5. The record identifying the office/designation to which complaint [reference] was assigned and the dates of recorded transfers or action.

Preferred access: [electronic copies where held and available in that form / certified paper copies / inspection followed by selected copies].

If any requested part is held by another public authority and transfer is applicable under section 6(3), please transfer that part and inform me. If disclosure of a part is refused, please identify the applicable provision, give the decision and reasons, and supply any reasonably separable disclosable portion under section 10. Where relevant, please consider section 8(2); any specific public-interest grounds are: [state factual grounds or remove]. Please provide the relevant appeal particulars.

Please inform me of any additional fee with its calculation and payment instructions before supplying chargeable copies.

Application fee: [accepted payment mode and receipt/reference]
OR fee-exemption claim: [BPL status and applicable proof; remove if not applicable]

Name: [name]
Postal address for correspondence: [address]
Email: [if desired]
Phone: [if desired/required by the selected portal]
Signature: [if on paper]

Attachments: [fee receipt/exemption proof; minimal identifying location/reference material]

Keep separately: full submitted application, receipt, date of actual receipt by the authority, registration number, transfer/additional-fee notices and calculated response deadline.

This template requests records. Submit a separate complaint if you also want inspection or corrective action. Access remains subject to the Act's disclosure, exemption and third-party provisions.

The personal-information exemption was amended through DPDP Act section 44(3). Avoid unnecessary personal identifiers; request redacted records where appropriate. Disclosure and public-interest balancing require a decision under the current law.
